PAKISTAN BAR COUNCILS EMPLOYEES SERVICE (AMENDMENT) RULES, 2000
PAKISTAN BAR
COUNCILS EMPLOYEES SERVICE
(AMENDMENT) RULES,
2000
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part II, 4th August, 2000]
S.R.O.537(I)/2000, dated
29-7-2000.--In exercise of the powers conferred by section 55 of the Legal
Practitioners and Bar Councils Act, 1973 (XXXV of 1973), and all other enabling
provisions in this behalf, the Pakistan Bar Council hereby makes the following
amendments in the Pakistan Bar Councils Employees Service Rules, 1976:--
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) These Rules may be called the Pakistan Bar Councils
Employees Service (Amendment) Rules, 2000.
(2) They shall come into force at
once.
2. Amendment of Rules 13 and
13A.--The existing Rules 13 and 13A may be substituted by the following:--
RULE 13
Grant of leave:
(A) Leave with pay.--The
maximum period of leave on full salary that may be granted at one time shall be
as follows:--
(i) without medical
certificate.
120 days.
(ii) with medical certificate
Plus-
180 days.
(iii) on medical certificate
from leave account in entire service
365 days
(b) Leave without pay.--The
Executive Committee for cogent reasons may allow leave without pay for such
period as it may deem fit.
(c) Leave preparatory to
retirement.--Subject to availability, the maximum period which an employee
may be granted as leave preparatory to retirement shall be 365 days, on payment
of full salary.
(d) Extraordinary Leave (leave
without pay).--It may be granted on any ground up to maximum period of five
years at time, provided that the employee to whom such leave is granted has
been in continuous service for a period of not less than ten years; in case the
employee has not completed ten years of continuous service, extraordinary leave
without pay for a maximum period of two years may be granted at the discretion
of the appointing authority.
RULE 13-A
(1) Encashment of refused
leave.--If in case of retirement on attaining the age of superannuation, an
employee, for reasons of public service be granted leave preparatory to
retirement duly applied for in sufficient time, he will in lieu thereof be
granted lump sum leave salary for the leave refused to him, subject to a
maximum of 180 days leave, on full, salary:
Provided that the appointing
authority at any time, allow to an employee encashment of refused earned leave.
(2) In service death.--In
case an employee died while in service, lump sum payment equal to full salary
of the accumulated Earned Leave at his credit, shall be made to his family and,
in case there is no Earned Leave available at the time of death of the
employee, the family shall be paid full salary up to 180."
3. Addition of provisos to
Rule 30.--Following proviso may be added to clause (i) of Rule 30:--
"Provided that' in the event
of resignation the employee concerned shall be paid the said benefit at half
the rate mentioned therein. However, this shall not effect the employees who
have already completed 10 years of service with the Pakistan Bar Council.
Provided further that the period of previous service of an
employee of the Pakistan Bar Council with a Provincial Bar Council, without any
break, shall be treated as service of the Pakistan Bar Council for commutation
of Gratuity."
